Name: Shockah's Modest Greenhouse
Author: Shockah
Description:
Expands the greenhouse a tiny bit to perfectly fit 3 Iridium Sprinklers with Pressure Nozzles and 8/16 fruit trees, in a configurable layout.

Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher.

Additionally lets you configure the layout via a config.json or Generic Mod Config Menu.
Available layout values are: Trees-Plot, Plot-Trees, Trees-Trees-Plot, Trees-Plot-Trees, Plot-Trees-Trees
